reviews.text: E02 6/5* "He's texting me all the time. He calls me, like, nonstop. He bought me a new car." "Dee, are you seriously bragging about sleeping with a married man?" "Yeah, one second you're on your high horse about how great marriage is and now you're destryoing one?" "Well, I'm not the one who's married. I didn't do anything wrong." "You let him buy you a car." "Well, Frank, I'm not gonna go passing on free cars." "Guys, guys, guys, guys, guys. All this talk about marriage and Dee being such a whore has got me thinking. I never got a bachelor party. We should go to the strip club." (...) "DIVORCE!" "What? What did you just say?" "I will divorce you, Maureen. I'll do it." "Okay, you're drunk. Why don't we just go to bed-" "I'm not drunk. I'm more sober than I've ever been in my entire life. Okay, I'm a little bit drunk- I'm totally drunk, but my mind is sober. And my mind's telling me the following: I don't love you, Maureen. I don't love you. I never loved you. You're annoying, and you're strange." "I don't know what to say." "Don't say anything. 'Cause every time you open your mouth, I'm, like, ohh! It's like her breath is, like, always so bad.  It's like a dead tooth- it's the dead tooth. I'm saying it now. I'll say it. You have a dead tooth. You realize that, right? And I hate it! And it's annoying!" "I want you and your boy toy out of my apartment now!" (Dennis and Mac laughing) Mac: "I'm the boy toy." "You're my boy toy. No, I'm not gonna leave our apartment- Or should I say my apartment- 'cause it's my apartment." "Oh, yeah? How about if you guys don't leave, I call the cops and I tell them you beat me?" "What in the hell are you talking about? I didn't touch you." (Maureen starts hitting herself in chest) "What-What- What are you doing? What is that? I recognize that. What is that?" "Oh, shit! That's from- That's from Fear, dude." "Oh, that's Marky Mark." "That's Marky Mark. That's what Marky Mark does. He does that. And then, um- and then the cops come in and he gets. The police think that William Peterson-" "And he gets it." "The guy from C.S.I.-" "Go! she means business."´(...) P. Diddy style parties (this aged well). (...) IMPLICATION. (Dennis) (...) "Goddamit! I've been cleaning up in there for hours, throwing this shit overboard, and you're just dragging it all back up." (...) "...and you're not even listening to me." "No, I heard you. You said a bunch of words. Look at this." (...) Charlie (dressed as Phantom of the Opera): "Yea, dude" I'm doing the vampire thing, 'cause chicks are all into vampires and stuff, you know, 'cause of the stupid Twilight movie and all that other crap. You know, so I'm like, what if the waitress is into it? This is my best shot!" Dennis: "You are dressed like the Phantom of the Opera. He's not a vampire." Charlie: "He eats theater people." Dennis: "No, he doesn't." Mac: "I think he might." Frank: "He does." Dennis: "And I'm surprised you even know who the Phantom of the Opera is." Mac: "He might not." Frank: "He doesn't." Charlie: "No, I don't. I don't." (Dee enters) "This party blows. There's no studs here. No beef in the freezer, if you know what I mean." (...) S06e07 again genius. Versions of story by every character take on each other. S06 musím už dát pět, je tu několik absolutně geniálních epizod i ikonických hlášek (...) "Don't flush." (OMG) ... (guys maniacally knocking on the door) "Deandra!" "Yeah!" "This is bad! This is real bad!" "You thought you had sex with Charlie, but it was Dennis that you went into the back room with. See?" "I had sex with you. It was sex with me. It was sex with me." "He threw up the whole way over here, Dee. Dennis is the father of that baby." "We got to get you and that monster that's in your gut down to Mexico A.S.A.P.!" "Are you kidding me? I did not have sex with Dennis." (reaction on not finding out none of them is father, ROFL) "Yea, but I'll tell you what. I'm not gonna tell you who the father is." "Who gives a shit?" "Yeah." "You all give a shit. You just said so. You were up all night. You were thinking about it all night long." "Yea, but that was before, when you said it was one of us. Now that it's not one of us, I mean-" "Who cares?" "Who cares, right" "It's no big deal." "Yea, who cares." (...)Ceremonial musicfor Schmitty. (...) Taky insane cameos (Paul Walter Hauser jako juggalo student, Tom Sizemore jako perv truck driver, Jason Sudeikis) (...) "All right. Tell you what, I'll take him to the locker room, lather him up real good. I'll strip all these silly-ass clothes of him, and I'll clean him sparkling clean. Brand-new kid for you. Bring him back up." "Please don't bathe the students." "You're right. He's a big man. He can bathe himself, can't you, Rich?" "Yeah, dawg." "He's bathing himself, and I'm watching." (...) Lethal Weapon 5. Blackface. (...) "What is your spaghetti policy here?" HAHAHA! (...) (Charlie and Frank in sauna, Charlie in clothes, in sauna for first time) "Dude, how much longer do we have to stay in here?" "Come on. Just relax. Take your clothes off." "I feel trapped in here, Frank. I'm trapped like a rat. Holy shit, I'm trapped like a rat, aren't I?" "No, you're not, Charlie." "I'm rat in here! I'm a rat! I'm trapped like a- AAAAA! I gotta get out of here." "Calm down, Charlie." "I'm tired of being in weird places, Frank, 'cause I'm trapped like a rat! I gotta get out of here!" "Now, calm down." "How do I get this off?" "Take it easy. Take it easy." "Just bash me, Frank." "No, I'm not gonna bash you, Charlie." "Just bash me like a rat!" (...) "What do we got going on over here, guys?" "Well, Charlie, when we thought it was your birthday, we went through your dream book and we tried to re-create some of the stuff we found in there." "Yes, that's okay. um- Denim chicken?" "YES!" "Yeah, denim chicken." "Now I got to reroute the pig delivery." "Nobody gives a shit." "So, we also have the bird, with teeth." "Yep." "Wow! Okay. And I'm assuming the teeth are fake, yes?" "Yes. Well, they're not real human teeth, if that's what you're asking me." "No, I mean, did you discover a bird with teeth in this fashion?" "That does not exist in nature." "Okay. I'm not sure about that, but either way, good glue work." "Do any of you assholes wanna know how old I am?" "Whatever, Frank." "Nobody-" "All right, so-" "So, Charlie, this is my favourite part. We werem't quite sure about what a worm hat was, right? So we made a few of them. This is the first one, it's the hat made of worms. And the option number two is a hat that you put on and when you do that, you look like maybe you're a worm." "Like a worm, yeah." "And then the third one- and this is the best one is a hat for your worm." "Your teeny tiny little worm gets a teeny tiny little hat." "So which one is it? Which one were you talking about?" "Well, I don't recall ever writing "worm hat." "Yeah, yeah, yeah. It was in your dream book. Your-" "Oh! Wermhat. Yea. That's a German guy. His name's Hans Wermhat. He appears in my dreams. He drives a biplane and he shoots at at me and I run through a field." "You know what? You guys blow. I'm gonna go find Duncan." (...) "But listen, you would consider me a pretty methodical person, wouldn't you?" "Oh, yeah, like a serial killer." "Haha, serial killer. I like that. I like that. It's a little bit of an exaggeration, but I see your point." "Yeah." "And I like it. I take it as a compliment. Well, listen, sometimes even I can't control everything. So when a nex experience presents itself to me I try to stay open to it and just say yes." "Say yes, huh?" "Yeah, Hey, let me show you something." "You'(re wearing a makeup?" "I'm always wearing a little bit of foundation, but that's not the point. What do you see there?" "Oh, shit! You got a lesion, dude." "No, it's not- That's not a lesion, dude. It's a hickey. Never seen a hickey?" "No, I have. Eew! Weird! I thought women our age didn't give hickeys anymore." "Oh, no, they don't. Young ladies do though. And I met an extremely young lady the other day, and she gave me this hickey." "Weeird!" "No, she was legal. She was totally legal. I always check their licenses. That's not the point." (...) Soul rabbit. "Nature is bullshit." (...) "(Sperm) It doesn't eat the egg and grow strong and become a baby?" (Charlie xd) (...) Bashing nerds (raising kids) (...) "I couldn't decide who the dad was, so I brought everybody." "You didn't try and decide who the dad was. You just got high." "Well, the interrogation did turn into a coke party."(...) "If we knew you were doimg this stupid surrogate thing again, we would have just completely ignored your pregnancy." "You did ignore my pregnancy." (...) "No, your other left." "Uh, my other left? I only have one left." "It's just an expression. Just move it to the other direction." "What would that expression be for - for someone who has two lefts?" "No-No. Just move it the other way. Move it the other way." "Towards your left." "Your left and my left are the same 'cause we're facing the same direction!" "E-e! We're two different people. We can't have the same left. It doesn't make sense." (...) "So son, what would you like for Christmas, huh?" "Did you fuck my mum?" Christmas special je insane. Jestliže se bavíme o nekorektním humoru a geniálních postavách, tohle je 6 z 5* série. (...) "Just throw the rocks at the train, you'll feel a lot better." Navíc 2010, to pro mě byl silný rok. Rok plný nového. Tahle show začíná být vážně něco.(26.10.2024)méněvíce

reviews.text: Pár epizod je extrémně přestřelených a stále si nejsem schopný vybrat kdo z party je větší hovado, ale přistoupil sem na jejich hru a místy je to dost vtipné. I když pořád trochu jinak než sem na úplném začátku čekal…70%(19.12.2023)
